0 grammar ::= remember stmtseq
1 grammar ::= remember stmtseq sideff
2 bare_statement_block ::= block cont
3 bare_statement_expression ::= sideff PERLY_SEMICOLON
4 bare_statement_null ::= PERLY_SEMICOLON
5 block ::= PERLY_BRACE_OPEN remember stmtseq PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE
6 block ::= PERLY_BRACE_OPEN remember stmtseq sideff PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE
7 empty ::=
8 remember ::=
9 stmtseq ::= empty
10 stmtseq ::= stmtseq fullstmt
11 fullstmt ::= barestmt
12 barestmt ::= bare_statement_block
13 barestmt ::= bare_statement_expression
14 barestmt ::= bare_statement_null
15 sideff ::= expr
16 cont ::= empty
17 expr ::= listexpr
18 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA
19 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA term
20 listexpr ::= term
21 termbinop ::= term ASSIGNOP term
22 term ::= termbinop
23 term ::= scalar
24 term ::= star
25 term ::= hsh
26 term ::= ary
27 term ::= arylen
28 term ::= THING
29 term ::= amper
30 amper ::= PERLY_AMPERSAND BAREWORD
31 scalar ::= PERLY_DOLLAR
32 ary ::= PERLY_SNAIL
33 hsh ::= PERLY_PERCENT_SIGN
34 arylen ::= DOLSHARP
35 star ::= PERLY_STAR BAREWORD
